memory_stress_note: The N8192/N32768 cases repeat retained real rows and are not quality/online workload evidence. They ran before the wrap constructor began reusing already prepared inverse blocks; conversion arithmetic is unchanged. Current constructor and prepared-feature callback are rechecked on N359/N1024 in gpu2_final.json.
numerical_note: Near-zero newborn-code roundtrips involve offset cancellation: relative error can be large while absolute differences remain <=8.6e-6 in the N32768 pressure case. Final real mixed-source case at N359 is bitwise equal for tile128; repeated N1024 differs <=2.0e-6. Neither exact-bit equality for all shapes nor unlimited-version stability is claimed.
limitations: No extra persistent per-row state, but original RelaySession append/FIFO may temporarily allocate new tensors.
Synchronous detached inference conversion only; calibration keeps the old differentiable path.
Allocated-memory peaks are conversion-only, not full service resident/transition memory or latency.
Chunking changes memory and launch geometry, not theoretical per-row FLOPs.
